question: Within the complete declared tiny-field candidate and relation-word populations, can a bounded public twist-threshold selector improve independent original-curve relation rank without increasing the declared paid-work vector relative to matched ordinary selectors?

claims.text: The run exhausts exactly the declared finite coefficient, selector-word, public-target and eight-step relation-word domains, including failures and ineligible model dispositions.
claims.if_supported: Report the reconciled finite census and its exact scope.
claims.if_not_supported: Mark incomplete or invalid; retain partial records and missing-domain identities.

claims.text: A twist selector may Pareto-improve the exact unconditional rank-survival distribution and declared paid-work vector for a specifically identified matched coefficient-model/base-size cell.
claims.if_supported: Report only the identified finite cells and exact componentwise differences; no runtime, GAE, asymptotic, algebraic-track or ECDLP-solving claim.
claims.if_not_supported: Retain ties, worse cells, failed selectors and mixed tradeoffs; do not infer universal nonexistence.

claims.text: The fixed positive-rank fixture and B2 negative-control fixture are detected and independently replayed before a field census can be accepted.
claims.if_supported: Retain controls.json and independent verification receipts.
claims.if_not_supported: Invalidate the affected shard and combined result.

claims.text: Universal twist advantage, arbitrary fields or walks, scalar recovery, algebraic index-calculus progress, admitted runtime gains, fastest-tool rankings, matched-rho advantage and resumable execution are outside this finite experiment.

arms.description: Baseline: accept the first B distinct original-curve x coordinates from every IID length-8 candidate word; canonical point signs and ordering.
Contextual reference: every x0 in Fp and nonzero delta in Fp yields an eight-candidate arithmetic progression; the same acceptance and canonicalization as random.
Accept distinct original-curve coordinates whose next one field coordinate is twist-only; no free full-field character table.
Accept distinct original-curve coordinates whose next two consecutive field coordinates are twist-only.
Accept distinct original-curve coordinates whose next three consecutive field coordinates are twist-only.
Accept distinct original-curve coordinates whose next four consecutive field coordinates are twist-only.
Reference: accept a candidate iff the complete canonical trial pair-sum table has no collision; charge all trial work and reuse the final accepted table.

Auxiliary instrument fixture, not an eighth selector: p7,a0,b3,n13,G=(1,2),Q=G,base[(1,2),(2,2)], word GGQQGGGG must attain coefficient rank3 by prefix6; execute once per field job and retain controls.json.

Auxiliary nonvacuous fixed B2 fixture must have three distinct pair sums; each real shard also checks this for every completed canonical B2 base. This detects accidental selector-specific coverage claims at B2.

aa.not_applicable_reason: The primary quantities are exact finite-population integers/rationals, not sampled estimates or clocks. Deterministic replay and a separate arithmetic/rank verifier must reproduce them exactly; a stochastic A/A noise interval is inapplicable. Development timing calibration is separate and cannot support an algorithm comparison.

positive.expected_detection: Each field-job copy verifies the public GGQQGGGG fixture, whose prefix2/4/6 coefficient rows [2,0,0],[1,1,11],[0,2,11] have full rank3 over F13 by prefix6; independent arithmetic and batch-rank verification agree.

null_population.generator: Fixed p7,a0,b3 fixture and complete canonical-base census already present in each field shard; no random resampling.
null_population.why_n: Three actual field-job copies of the fixed fixture are required; all completed B2 bases add exact validation checks rather than sampled null replicates.

variable_ledger.aa_not_applicable: Exact finite population; no timed primary or stochastic sampling noise.

randomization.arm_order_reason: All primary quantities are exact operation-count distributions from the same pure interpreter. Fixed lexicographic traversal cannot allocate a cold-start clock cost to an arm; no elapsed-time comparison is admitted.

seed_derivation.note: There is no random seed draw: the frozen enumerator exhausts every IID candidate word in Fp^8 by weighted state DP, every affine progression start/nonzero-step, every nonzero public target, and every binary relation word in {G,Q}^8. Field IDs p7,p11,p19 identify the three export instances.

instance_sampling.rule: No sampling. All 49+121+361 coefficient-model dispositions across p7,p11,p19, both B2/B3 values, all declared selector inputs and all declared public relation inputs are enumerated. Isomorphic models remain separately identified; they are not statistical independent draws.

blinding.how: The full exact census and frozen arithmetic comparisons are reported without data-dependent thresholds or model fitting; no analyst blinding claim is made.

power.note: Complete finite populations, not sampled statistical tests. Alpha is a schema-required placeholder and is unused. The single predeclared componentwise decision family has no p-values or sampling intervals; no power or generic-curve generalization is claimed.

primary.name: Unconditional coefficient-rank survival
primary.unit: exact rational probability for each rank/prefix
primary.definition: For each fixed eligible model and B, count every candidate word, nonzero target and relation word uniformly within its declared population. Selector failures contribute rank0. Report P(rank>=r) for every r1..B+1 and every prefix, with full-rank absorption.
primary.source: per-cell selector weights combined with relation rank_hist_by_prefix
primary.resolution: Exact integer or rational; large integers serialized as decimal strings.

primary.name: Unconditional paid-work vector
primary.unit: native primitive counts, separately by unit
primary.definition: Charge candidate reads/draws, characters, roots, field operations, duplicate/order checks, trial tables, pair setup, query search, elimination and public relation verification to every conceptual cold execution; for each rank milestone use first-attainment work or full-budget work when missing. Compare exact unconditional sum/denominator expectations, retaining sums and attained/missing partitions, not a distribution of individual work values. Never average only survivors.
primary.source: selection outcomes work_sum plus weighted relation total_work_sum and milestone work_sum
primary.resolution: Exact integer or rational; large integers serialized as decimal strings.

stopping_rules.rule: Complete the full three-field finite domain and all declared model dispositions, selector populations, target/query-word populations and control receipts; no stopping because a result appears favorable.

A selector stops upon B distinct accepted points or eight visited candidates; unread suffixes preserve probability mass without work. A relation case stops at coefficient rank B+1 or eight G/Q increments.
Each physical field job has the fixed1800-second job deadline. Preserve partial output and identify missing cells if interrupted; no automatic retry, no interpreting an incomplete manifest as a pass.

An invalid point/relation, cost/census overflow or reconciliation failure, missing mandatory control, independent-verifier mismatch, missing shard, source/protocol identity mismatch or checkpoint-gate failure invalidates the affected result.

decision_rule.text: For each explicitly named matched eligible model/B cell, a twist arm is within-model Pareto-improved only if its unconditional P(rank>=r) is no lower for every rank r1..B+1 at every prefix0..8 and each unconditional expected total and rank-milestone paid-work vector is componentwise no greater than the stated IID reference, with at least one strict improvement. Expectations are exact sum/denominator ratios, not stochastic dominance of individual work values. Otherwise report tie, worse or mixed tradeoff exactly. Report every field/B/threshold separately and preserve all failing mass; do not choose L from pooled outcomes. Counter incompleteness forbids a physical runtime or complete GAE/ECDLP cost ranking.
decision_rule.threshold: Componentwise exact weak improvement in every declared utility/work component and strict improvement in at least one, for a stated matched finite cell.
decision_rule.statistic: Exact rational componentwise contrasts by model, B and fixed threshold; explicit counts of ties, worse cells and mixed tradeoffs.
decision_rule.interval: Exact finite-population values; no sampling interval or p-value.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Exact signed componentwise differences and rational ratios where denominators are nonzero; undefined ratios remain undefined.

inadmissible: Calling p^8 subset-state DP elapsed time the runtime of a selector, or memoized relation-audit elapsed time the cold relation finder.
Dropping rejected candidates, incomplete bases, rank-budget failures, ineligible model dispositions or interrupted shards.
Survivor-only means, free full-field character tables, or known scalar/base-log oracle data inside selection or relation search.
Treating raw hits, bigger sumsets or rank of the augmented RHS as independent coefficient-rank improvement.
Pooling fields or B values to select a threshold after observing data.
Adding unlike primitive counts into a physical-time or complete GAE claim; allocator/cache/branch/RNG-internal and byte-peak-memory prices remain unmeasured.
Claiming algebraic-track progress, sub-rho or generic-curve/asymptotic security consequences from the generic pair-table census.
Changing an existing frozen protocol, raw record or scientific ledger in place after affected data are taken.
Calling source/evidence S3 checkpoint retention process-memory recovery or automatic resumability.

extensions.track: generic decomposition (bounded by sqrt(r); cannot beat rho)

finite_scope.eligible: nonsingular and prime original order n>=7
finite_scope.canonical_generator: smallest canonical original-curve point by x then y
finite_scope.iid_domain: Fp^8; every length8 word has equal multiplicity
finite_scope.progression_domain: every (x0,delta) in Fp x Fp*; candidate_j=x0+j*delta modp
finite_scope.relation_domain: every Q!=O for canonical G and every word in {G,Q}^8, starting a=b=0
finite_scope.pair_tie: first lexicographic canonical i<=j pair per sum

export_layout.b_handling: B2 and B3 retain separate metric/counter keys and raw model data within each selector field row; they are never averaged together.
export_layout.missing_shards_policy: The 27-row table is complete acceptance only. Partial exports include actual attempted execution receipts; never fabricate attempts for unattempted missing shards. Retain expected27/missing IDs in backend metadata/observations; canonical flow reconciles actual rows and incomplete export exits nonzero.

extensions.source_checkpoint: Source/spec/lead S3 preflight and per-field start gates are mandatory before each census begins. Each field attempts a finish checkpoint retaining its actual native outcome and partial outputs; aggregate attempts an evidence checkpoint after reporting. Per-run/attempt/field/phase prefixes prevent collisions; checkpoint failure fails the job without replacing the original native failure. Maintained transport file-size/total-size caps apply, and abrupt Spot pod loss may prevent final upload. These source/evidence checkpoints are independent of execution.checkpoint.policy none because process-memory/application resume is not implemented.
cost_model_gaps: RNG internal bit-generation/rejection cost behind abstract random_draws
audit DP/trie memoization, independent verification and serialization/evidence-IO overhead excluded from the modeled algorithm count vector
